{{Top|leg}}
A '''longo''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] measurement of underwater speed. 100 longos was considered fast enough to outswim a [[Klaa fish]], and thus was the minimum speed requirement for a [[Bongo]] to be entered in the [[Otoh Gunga Challenge]].
